warnings: Footnote reads 'เข็มเจาะ คสล. Ø0.35 ยาว 21ม. F1 = [glyph] หลุม = [glyph] ต้น' — the pile-count glyph is a hand-drawn double vertical stroke that could read as Thai digit 1 (stylised with a serif) or as a tally '2'. Resolved as 1 pile per footing by cross-checking against หน้า18's PLAN_F1, which draws exactly ONE hatched pile shaft centered in the 0.70x0.70m footing (a 2-pile footing at this size/spacing would not physically fit two 350mm-diameter piles with adequate edge distance). Recorded pile count=1; flagging the glyph ambiguity here rather than silently picking a reading.

All 11 footings on this sheet are the single type F1 (0.70x0.70m mat, one Ø0.35m bored pile). Column marks above them differ (C1 at 10 positions, C2 at grid B2 only, per the SECTION COLUMN schedule on หน้า19) — per spec §4 a point element (footing) merges into ONE entry regardless of a differing neighbouring column mark, so this is recorded as a single F1 entry with a note on the C1/C2 split rather than two entries.
Grid D1 (bottom-left of the 3x4 grid) carries no footing marker — consistent with the architecture floor plan, where that corner is an open carport (จอดรถ) with no enclosing wall/column there.

elements.note: column mark above each footing (per หน้า19's SECTION COLUMN schedule): column-mark 'C2' at grid point B2 only; column-mark 'C1' at all 10 other grid points listed (A1, A2, A3, B1, B3, and the three at row C plus D2/D3) — note row 'C' (a grid row label) and column-mark 'C1'/'C2' are unrelated, printed coincidences of the same letter
